subject: Next steps: NorthBridge Bank x Redwood Private/VPC technical deep dive
body:
From: Avery Johnson <avery@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@northbridgebank.com>
Cc: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@northbridgebank.com>
Date: Sat, Jan 10, 2026 at 4:12 PM
Subject: Next steps: NorthBridge Bank x Redwood Private/VPC technical deep dive

Maya — thank you again for the time yesterday.

Recap (to make sure we captured it correctly):
- Use case: internal agent assist + comms review workflows, with peak loads during market hours.
- Key requirements: predictable latency/throughput, strong tenant/data isolation, and auditability suitable for your SOC + risk teams.
- Deployment: strong preference for VPC/private networking; avoid sending regulated content over public internet.
- Security items you called out: audit log export (ideally to Splunk), encryption at rest/in transit, and KMS key control options.

Suggested next step: a 45-min technical deep dive on Redwood Private/VPC with our Solutions Engineering lead (Markus Klein) to walk through the reference architecture and confirm networking/logging assumptions.

A few time options (ET):
- Tue 1/13: 11:00–11:45am
- Wed 1/14: 2:00–2:45pm
- Thu 1/15: 9:30–10:15am

If none of those work, send 2–3 windows and we’ll align.

As promised, attaching:
1) FinServ Private deployment deck (talk track + architecture)
2) FinServ security FAQ addendum (audit logging, retention/residency posture, SSO/RBAC, KMS options)

Also here are the same links:
- Deck: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NBR-FIN-Deck-v1/view
- Security FAQ: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NBR-FinServ-SecFAQ-Addendum/view

One question for your platform team ahead of the deep dive: are you thinking VPC peering, PrivateLink, or VPN as the preferred connectivity pattern?

Best,
Avery

Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0139

Attachments:
- Redwood_FinServ_Private_Deployment_Pitch_Deck_v1.pdf
- Redwood_ABM_FinServ_Security_FAQ_Addendum.pdf

From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@northbridgebank.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@northbridgebank.com>
Date: Sun, Jan 11, 2026 at 9:02 AM
Subject: Re: Next steps: NorthBridge Bank x Redwood Private/VPC technical deep dive

Thanks Avery — recap looks right.

Let’s do Tue 1/13 at 11:00am ET.

Re: connectivity, we typically start with PrivateLink where possible. Peering is also feasible depending on account boundaries. We can cover details on the call.

Can you include someone who can speak to audit log contents/format and what’s available by default vs. configuration?

Maya

From: Avery Johnson <avery@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@northbridgebank.com>
Cc: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@northbridgebank.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Jan 11, 2026 at 9:18 AM
Subject: Re: Next steps: NorthBridge Bank x Redwood Private/VPC technical deep dive

Perfect — booked for Tue 1/13 at 11:00am ET.

Looping in Markus Klein (cc’d) who will lead the deep dive. Markus can also walk through audit log event types and export options (e.g., JSON over HTTPS to SIEM collectors, S3 + forwarders, etc.) and what we typically see in regulated deployments.

Calendar invite coming shortly.

Thanks,
Avery

---

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@northbridgebank.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@northbridgebank.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 12, 2026 at 11:03 AM
Subject: Re: Next steps: NorthBridge Bank x Redwood Private/VPC technical deep dive

Maya — looking forward to Tuesday.

Ahead of the call, two quick items that will help us be concrete:
1) Preferred AWS region(s) for the initial evaluation (and any data residency constraints we should assume).
2) SIEM target for audit logs (you mentioned Splunk — is that Splunk Cloud or an on-prem indexer?).

On audit logging specifics, we’ll cover:
- What events are emitted (admin actions, authn/authz, model/route changes, request metadata, etc.)
- What’s optional (payload redaction controls, export destinations)
- Typical retention posture for Private/VPC deployments (customer-controlled)

See you then.

Markus

Markus Klein
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
